prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Tobias Reyne after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Charity admin modernisation
client: Oakfield Charities
client_industry: nonprofit
start: 2022-10
end: 2023-01
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Django
- PostgreSQL
- HTMX
- Celery
implied_skills:
- legacy migration
built: Upgraded a Django 1.11 donor system to Django 4.1 and rebuilt the donation
  entry screens with HTMX.
metrics:
- donation entry time down 45%
- zero data loss across 180k donor records

The review is from: Oakfield Charities
Rating: 4.0 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "legacy migration".
text: Tobias helped us modernise our charity admin system and upgraded our donor platform from Django 1.11 to Django 4.1. He also rebuilt the donation entry screens with HTMX, which made the process much faster for our team and cut donation entry time by 45%. We had zero data loss across our 180k donor records, which was the main thing we cared about. The work was solid, though there were a few delays and communication could have been a bit more proactive at times.
